abort.already_configured: PV Manager is already set up. Open the PV Manager dashboard – everything is managed there.

error.buttons_need_both: Please choose both a start and a stop button.
error.buttons_need_power: With „two buttons“ PVM needs a power sensor to know whether the device is currently running.

init.title: PV Manager – Management
init.description: What would you like to do? (Most actions are also available directly from the dashboard.)

messungen.title: Measurements (PV / grid / house)
messungen.description: Only enable what you actually have. PVM needs at least one PV or grid sensor – you can also add it later.

data.pv_enabled: I have a PV power sensor
data.house_enabled: I have a house consumption sensor

data_description.pv_sensor: Example: sensor.inverter_power or sensor.pv_yield – shows what your system currently produces.
data_description.grid_sensor: Example: sensor.shelly_grid_power – your meter at the grid connection.
data_description.grid_kind: Combined: import positive, export negative (common, e.g. Shelly 3EM). Export only: if only feed-in is measured.
data_description.house_sensor: Example: sensor.house_consumption. Only needed if no grid sensor exists.

add.title: Add device
add.description: What kind of device do you want to add?

data.device: Which device do you want to change?

device_basics.title: Device – basics
device_basics.description: How do you control this device? PVM will only show the matching fields in the next step.

data_description.name: For example „wallbox garage“ or „heat pump“.
data_description.control_type: One switch (on/off) – or two separate buttons for start and stop. Wallboxes can additionally limit the charging power.

device_fields.title: Device – entities & goals
device_fields.description: Assign the matching sensors. Leave fields empty if you have no matching entity.

data.name: Name
data.grid_min: Allow grid power for minimum SOC

data_description.number_entity: Example: number.wallbox_max_current (in A or kW) – PVM limits the power with it.
data_description.power_sensor: Example: sensor.wallbox_power (in W/kW). Required with „two buttons“.
data_description.capacity_kwh: How many kWh fit into the car (example: 60).
data_description.max_soc: Up to which level the car may charge (default 80 %).
data_description.min_soc: Safety target: if it is undercut, PVM also charges from grid power.

found.title: Found – what do you want to adopt?
found.description: PVM detected sensors and devices. Choose an entry – multiple hits can be reviewed one by one.

found_empty.title: Nothing new found
found_empty.description: There are no new suggestions. You can still add measurements and devices manually (menu „Measurements“ / „Devices“).

adopt_measure.title: Confirm sensor
adopt_measure.description: Is one of these sensors yours? The current value is shown in brackets so you can check whether it is the right one.

erweitert.title: Advanced settings
erweitert.description: Global values – most of them can also be adjusted directly in the dashboard.

data_description.reserve_w: Power kept as reserve (e.g. for passing clouds).
data_description.cycle_s: Interval between two control decisions (recommended: 30 s).
data_description.min_on_s: How long a device stays on at minimum after turning on (anti-flicker).
data_description.min_off_s: How long a device stays off at minimum after turning off.
